# FG-AUTH-0014

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`oidc-identity-link`](../../ops/runbooks/oidc-identity-link.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `identity_link_conflicts_name_their_reason` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このアカウントを GitStation の利用者に結び付けられませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: This account could not be linked to a GitStation user. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Akun ini tidak dapat ditautkan ke pengguna GitStation. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

At the first sign-in of an identity (issuer + subject not linked yet), GitStation neither linked it to an existing user nor created one (ADR-0021 §4): an e-mail address alone never links; an employee number links only together with a verified matching e-mail, only to a human non-administrator not yet linked to this issuer, and only with `auth.oidc.auto_link = true`; a new user needs the employee number claim, a verified e-mail and a free username and e-mail. Nothing was written. Also `forge admin user link-identity` when the identity or the user is already linked.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event `forge.auth.login_failed` (or the CLI's error) carries `reason` only — never the claims: employee_number_missing (the ID token has no `auth.oidc.employee_number_claim`), email_missing, email_unverified (`email_verified` is not true), email_mismatch (the employee number matched a user whose e-mail differs), privileged_account (the employee number belongs to an administrator: linked only by the operator), employee_number_linked (that user is linked to another subject of this issuer), auto_link_disabled (`auth.oidc.auto_link = false` and the employee number belongs to an existing user), username_unavailable (`preferred_username` missing, invalid, reserved, taken or tombstoned), email_taken (another user has the e-mail), employee_number_taken (a concurrent sign-in created a user with it first: retry), claim_invalid (with `detail`: a claim breaks a forge.users rule, e.g. an e-mail above 320 characters); CLI: subject_linked (the identity belongs to another user), already_linked (the user has an identity of this issuer).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook oidc-identity-link: find the person by employee number and e-mail in the identity provider and in GitStation, decide whom the identity belongs to, and link it as an approved step with `forge admin user link-identity --user <username> --issuer <issuer> --subject <sub>`; or fix the claim mappers (employee_number, email_verified) in the realm.
